1523101.name: Holy Grace
1523101.description: Fires an energy sphere, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1523103.name: Hallowed Trail
1523103.description: Fires a golden energy sphere, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The energy sphere can be intercepted.

1523105.name: Golden Crux
1523105.description: A golden cross emits a burst of light, dealing damage to the Nikke with the highest ATK.

1523107.name: Prayer
1523107.description: Discharges an energy wave, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1523109.name: Strongest Shield on the Surface
1523109.description: Altruia activates Saintess's Halos, which grant her increased ATK and invulnerability after a certain amount of time. Attacking the halos will cause them to deactivate.

1523111.name: Garden of Altruism
1523111.description:
Emits a burst of energy, dealing lethal damage to all Nikkes.
This attack can be interrupted via Special Interruption.

1523112.name: Blessing
1523112.description:
Fires a ring-shaped energy beam, dealing massive damage to all Nikkes.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while Cancel Rings are active. While the barrier is up, only Electric Code Nikkes can deal damage.

1523121.name: Holy Light
1523121.description: Fires a burst of energy, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1523122.name: Holy Breath
1523122.description: Fires off a blast of energy, dealing damage to all Nikkes. Destroy the Almighty Shields to interrupt the attack.
